instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: Which is the present simple passive of 'they make it'?
questions.explanation: The present simple passive uses am/is/are with the past participle of the verb.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول في المضارع البسيط يستخدم am/is/are مع اسم المفعول.

questions.question: They made it yesterday. Which passive form is correct?
questions.explanation: The past simple passive uses was or were with the past participle, and it is singular.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول في الماضي البسيط يستخدم was أو were مع اسم المفعول، والمفرد يأخذ was.

questions.question: They are being made. Which form is this?
questions.explanation: Are being plus the past participle marks a passive action happening right now.
questions.explanation_ar: are being مع اسم المفعول تدل على فعل مبني للمجهول يحدث الآن.

questions.question: Which is the past perfect passive of 'they had made it'?
questions.explanation: The past perfect passive is had been plus the past participle.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول في الماضي التام هو had been مع اسم المفعول.

questions.question: Which tense is 'they will have been made'?
questions.explanation: The future perfect passive is will have been plus the past participle.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول في المستقبل التام هو will have been مع اسم المفعول.

questions.question: They have been made. What does this form express?
questions.explanation: Have been plus the past participle is the present perfect passive, a finished act with present result.
questions.explanation_ar: have been مع اسم المفعول هي المضارع التام للمجهول، فعل منتهٍ نتيجته الآن.

questions.question: Which tense has no continuous passive form?
questions.explanation: The chart leaves the future continuous passive empty, while present and past both have one.
questions.explanation_ar: الجدول يترك المستقبل المستمر بلا صيغة مجهولة، بينما المضارع والماضي لهما صيغة.

questions.question: The house was painted by Ali. Why is 'by Ali' added?
questions.explanation: In a passive sentence the agent is optional and is introduced by by when it matters.
questions.explanation_ar: في الجملة المبنية للمجهول يكون الفاعل اختيارياً ويُقدَّم بـ by عندما يهمّ ذكره.

questions.question: Which is the future simple passive of 'they will make it'?
questions.explanation: The future passive is will be plus the past participle.
questions.explanation_ar: المستقبل للمجهول هو will be مع اسم المفعول.

questions.question: They have been made. Which form is this?
questions.explanation: Have been plus the past participle is the present perfect passive.
questions.explanation_ar: have been مع اسم المفعول هي المضارع التام للمجهول.

questions.question: Why is the passive used in 'The window was broken last night'?
questions.explanation: The passive lets the sentence drop the doer when nobody knows who did it.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول يتيح حذف الفاعل حين لا يُعرف من فعله.

questions.question: Which is the passive of 'they must check it'?
questions.explanation: A modal takes be plus the past participle in the passive.
questions.explanation_ar: الفعل الناقص يأخذ be مع اسم المفعول في المبني للمجهول.
